title: Stored plasma gas sold where it lies, at Node Beta, into the station's plasma bid
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 13:40 UTC (orders.log ENT-014, block APOLLO: sell what stands in storage). One hauler stores 83 plasma gas at Node Beta from the gas test of the morning (data/stock/storage.json, 12:24 UTC); the plasma bid there stood at 96 x 13 at 12:50 UTC and the withdraw step read 33 units at its best price at 13:28 UTC, when the step still counted the hold in units and was refused (plasma takes two units of space a piece; fixed in commit df8f6fb). The withdraw step takes what the bid takes and what the hold holds by size (32 a load); requires.bid closes the route while a book read within the hour shows under 5 units at 90 cr or more. Stored gas goes into the bid before any gas test's load does. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship until its first RESULT line.
